parsed.rationale: All four records are `type-alias-object` kinds with empty `fields_or_signature` lists, meaning the structural similarity is purely that they are zero-field type aliases — not that they alias the same underlying type or serve the same domain concept. `ApplicationWillTerminateMessage` (Core package, application lifecycle), `PlaybackStalledMessage` and `HLSPlaybackStalledMessage` (Playback package, two distinct playback-layer events), and `RequestSentMessage` (MusicShareKit package, network request signalling) each encode a distinct domain event in a distinct package. The shared shape is an artefact of the message-object pattern used throughout the codebase, not evidence of duplicated logic. Extracting or unifying them would conflate unrelated domain concepts and create spurious cross-package coupling.
